raw_text:
Below is a concise, integrated 12‑week program for your 36‑year‑old recreational lifter returning from a repaired right medial meniscus (cleared for low‑impact strength only). It combines strength, progressive cardio, recovery/mobility and nutrition guidance so he is strongest and ski‑ready by week 12. I’ve kept all work knee‑safe (no jumping, no deep loaded knee flexion), prioritized hip/posterior‑chain strength, single‑leg control, and progressive volume/intensity. Use RPE and symptom monitoring to autoregulate — stop or regress any exercise that causes sharp pain, catching, or swelling.

Quick facts / assumptions
- Full gym available. No deep loaded squats below pain‑free range; use box squats, trap bar deadlifts, RDLs, hip thrusts, sleds, SkiErg, bike, rower.
- Training frequency: 5 days/week recommended (Mon–Fri) — 3 strength days (Mon/Wed/Fri), 2 cardio days (Tue/Thu). Optional light active recovery weekend work.
- Progression model: Phase 1 (Wks 1–4) build control/load tolerance; Phase 2 (Wks 5–8) increase volume & intensity (you asked to push volume weeks 4–8); Phase 3 (Wks 9–12) peak and taper to a fresh, strong Week 12.
- Nutrition goal: Maintain weight. Target maintenance calories (approx 33–35 kcal/kg initially), protein 1.6–2.0 g/kg, carbs 3–5 g/kg, maintain creatine 5 g/day, consider fish oil & vitamin D if needed.

Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4: Rebuild baseline, movement quality, load tolerance
Goals: Movement quality, glute/ham dominance, light unilateral control, low‑impact aerobic base.

Weekly template (Mon–Fri)
- Mon — Strength Lower emphasis
  - Warm up (8–10 min bike + activation)
  - Trap bar deadlift: 3×5–6
  - Box squat (controlled to box): 3×6–8 (3s eccentric, 1s pause)
  - Bulgarian split squat (limited depth): 3×8 each
  - Hamstring curl 3×10–12
  - Calf raise 3×10–15
  - Core: Pallof press 3×10/side
- Tue — Cardio 1 (low impact)
  - Week 1–2: Bike/SkiErg steady 20–30 min (Zone 2). Week 3–4: Intervals 6×2 min hard/1 easy (total 25–35 min).
- Wed — Strength Upper
  - Bench 4×5–6; Row 4×6–8; Overhead press 3×6–8; Pulldown 3×8–10; Face pulls 3×12–15; Dead bug 3×10/side.
- Thu — Cardio 2 (conditioning)
  - Sled pushes light 6×20–30 m OR SkiErg intervals 6–8 × (1.5 min /1.5 min). Mobility after.
- Fri — Strength Lower/glute focus
  - RDL 4×6–8; Hip thrust 4×8–10; Step‑ups low height 3×8 each; Lateral band walks 3×15 steps; Single‑leg RDL 3×8/side; Side plank 3×30–45s/side.
- Weekend — Active recovery: easy bike/walk 20–30 min, mobility work.

Progression through Phase 1
- Increase loads modestly if RPE ≤7 and no knee symptoms. Introduce TKEs and slight increases in single‑leg volume in Wks 3–4.

Phase 2 — Weeks 5–8: Strength focus, large volume & cardio push (progressive overload)
Goals: Increase strength, unilateral capacity, ski specificity, heavier posterior chain and higher cardio volume/intensity (you requested a real progression).

Weekly template (Mon–Fri) — higher volume
- Mon — Heavy Lower
  - Trap bar deadlift 4×4–5 (progress to heavier sets), Box squat 4×4–6, Bulgarian split 3–4×6–8, Glute‑ham or hamstring curl 3×6–8, Farmer carries 3×40–60 m.
